summary.text: Jennifer Stewart is a Democratic state representative from District 59 who took office on January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election; she advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Stewart lives in Pawtucket, Rhode Island, and earned a master's degree in political science from the University of Chicago, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes teaching history and political science at Moses Brown School in Providence.
